name: Anime highlight from a different angle
prompt_reference: Generate a highly accurate anime rendition of this scene from an angle where the face of the star player can be seen. Turn this into a dramatic anime scene where {description} is happening, highly stylized and pay attention to details.
prompt_template: Anime highlight edit of this moment: {{description}}. Emphasize drama and intensity.
ref_frame_prompt: Anime-style football highlight still frame. Show the action clearly: {description}. Vertical 9:16.

name: ESPN-style studio segment parody (ridicule/hot-take)
prompt_reference:
Create a short-form sports studio segment that FEELS like an ESPN/SportsCenter-style highlight breakdown, but as a parody.

Tone: smug, overproduced, overly-serious analysis of something obvious; lightly ridicules the network-style hot-take theatrics OR lightly ridicules the original play (but keep it playful, not hateful).

Visual language: polished studio lighting, dramatic camera moves, quick cutaways, replay-style angles, slow-motion emphasis, tasteful lens flares.

Important: Do NOT include any on-screen text, lower-thirds, scorebugs, captions, watermarks, logos, or split-screen panels. Convey the "ESPN segment" vibe through set design, lighting, and camera direction only.

Maintain player identity and uniforms, keep the action readable, and keep the scene coherent from beat 1 to beat 6.
prompt_template: ESPN-style studio breakdown parody of: {{description}}. Overproduced analysis vibe. No on-screen text.
ref_frame_prompt: Polished sports studio segment parody frame. Cinematic studio lighting. Show the key moment clearly: {description}. Optional analyst silhouette/desk in foreground. Vertical 9:16. No text.

name: Medieval reenactment highlight (period clothing + medieval English accents)
prompt_reference:
Transform this sports moment into a medieval reenactment of the same action.

Visual world: late medieval England vibe. Replace all modern elements (stadium, uniforms, pads, helmets, signage, modern lighting) with medieval equivalents: stone walls, wooden stands, banners without text, torchlight, muddy ground, cobblestones, countryside.

Characters: everyone is in period-accurate medieval clothing/armor (tunics, cloaks, leather jerkins, gambesons, simple mail). Keep the "star player" identifiable by consistent facial features and body language, but not by modern uniforms.

Action: preserve the core choreography so it is clearly the same play described by {description}. Make it readable and coherent. Use dramatic medieval cinematography: handheld grit, slow-motion impacts, dust/mud particles, cinematic torchlit highlights.

Audio: include spoken commentary as if from medieval English announcers with medieval English accents and archaic phrasing (e.g., "By my troth!", "Hark!", "Verily!"). Keep it energetic and humorous, but not hateful.

Important: Do NOT include any on-screen text, captions, watermarks, logos, modern UI, or modern broadcast graphics. No guns, no cars, no electricity, no neon, no smartphones.
prompt_template: Medieval reenactment highlight of this moment: {{description}}. Everyone in medieval clothing/armor. Torchlit, gritty, cinematic. Commentary in medieval English accents with archaic phrasing. No on-screen text.
ref_frame_prompt: Medieval reenactment highlight still frame. Period-accurate clothing/armor, torchlit scene, stone/wooden stands. Show the key action clearly: {description}. Vertical 9:16. No text.
